examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The site chrome around a page of sections: SiteHeaderSection with a mega-menu and the account actions, the hero and a framed section in the slot, and SiteFooterSection closing the frame. The bar's search opens the ⌘K palette with every navigation destination.

examples.name: Nav overlay
examples.summary: The bar floats over the first band instead of stacking above it, as on a home page whose hero fills the top of the window; it stays sticky to the end of the page and the footer still closes it.
